columns.name: whatsapp
columns.label: WhatsApp number
columns.help: International format, e.g. +971501234567.

columns.name: trn
columns.label: VAT TRN
columns.help: Your 15-digit Tax Registration Number. Once set, vouchers are titled Tax invoice.

columns.name: licence
columns.label: Licence to display
columns.help: For example DET tourism licence 1234567 or RTA car rental licence 7654321. Shown in the footer and on vouchers.

columns.name: deposit_percent
columns.label: Paid online by card (%)
columns.help: Share of the price paid by card to secure a reservation: 100 = pay in full, 20 = 20% now and the balance on the day, 0 = nothing online.

columns.name: pay_later_enabled
columns.label: Reserve now, pay on the day
columns.help: Lets customers reserve without paying online.

columns.name: free_cancel_hours
columns.label: Free cancellation until (hours before)
columns.help: Customers can cancel on the website until this many hours before the start. Refund what they paid in Stripe.

columns.name: days_ahead
columns.label: Bookable days ahead
columns.help: How far in the future customers can reserve, e.g. 60.

columns.name: category
columns.help: Items with the same category are listed together, e.g. Tours, Cars, Party rental.

columns.name: mode
columns.label: Sold as
columns.help: departure: seats on dated departures (tours, cruises). range: rented from a start date to an end date (cars, equipment).

columns.name: price_adult
columns.label: Price per adult (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: Tours only.

columns.name: price_child
columns.label: Price per child (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: Tours only. Leave empty to charge the adult price.

columns.name: price_day
columns.label: Price per day (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: Rentals only.

columns.name: price_week
columns.label: Price per week (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: Rentals only, optional: used for every full 7 days.

columns.name: stock
columns.label: Quantity owned
columns.help: Rentals only: how many you have. Reservations for more on the same days are refused.

columns.name: min_days
columns.label: Minimum days
columns.help: Rentals only.

columns.name: security_deposit
columns.label: Security deposit (AED)
columns.help: Rentals only: refundable, collected at handover and not charged online. Shown to the customer.

columns.name: duration
columns.label: Duration
columns.help: For example 6 hours.

columns.name: item_id
columns.label: Tour
columns.help: The # of the tour in Tours and rentals.

columns.name: date
columns.label: Date
columns.help: YYYY-MM-DD for a single departure. Leave empty for a departure that repeats on the weekdays below.

columns.name: weekdays
columns.label: Repeats on
columns.help: Used when Date is empty: daily, or weekdays separated by commas, e.g. fri,sat (mon tue wed thu fri sat sun).

columns.name: time
columns.label: Time
columns.help: HH:MM in UAE time, e.g. 15:30.

columns.name: capacity
columns.label: Seats
columns.help: Seats on each departure; reservations beyond this are refused.

columns.name: price
columns.label: Price per adult (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: Optional: replaces the tour's adult price for this departure, e.g. a weekend price.

columns.name: item_id
columns.label: Only for item
columns.help: The # of one tour or rental. Leave empty to use the category below.

columns.name: category
columns.label: Only for category
columns.help: Offered on every item of this category. Leave both empty to offer it on everything.

columns.name: per
columns.label: Charged per
columns.help: booking: once. person: per guest on a tour, per unit on a rental. day: per rental day.

columns.name: departure_id
columns.label: Departure
columns.help: Tours: the # of the departure.

columns.name: start_date
columns.label: Date / start date
columns.help: YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: end_date
columns.label: End date
columns.help: Rentals: the return date, YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: time
columns.label: Time
columns.help: Tours: departure time, HH:MM.

columns.name: quantity
columns.label: Quantity
columns.help: Rentals: how many units.

columns.name: due_online
columns.label: Due online (AED)
columns.help: The share to pay by card to secure the reservation.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: Pending, confirmed, completed and no_show hold the seats or stock; the others release them.

columns.name: notes
columns.label: Notes
columns.help: From the customer: pickup hotel, driving licence number, delivery address.

columns.name: pending_since
columns.label: Waiting for payment since
columns.help: UTC. The daily job expires reservations still unpaid two hours later.

business.name: Sahara Bay Tours & Rentals
business.tagline: Desert safaris, cruises, car hire and party rentals in Dubai
business.tagline_ar: رحلات سفاري وجولات بحرية وتأجير سيارات ومستلزمات حفلات في دبي
business.address: Office 804, Bay Square 3, Business Bay, Dubai
business.licence: DET tourism licence 1234567 · RTA car rental licence 7654321

items.name: Evening Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner
items.name_ar: سفاري صحراوي مسائي مع عشاء مشويات
items.description: Dune bashing in a 4x4 across the Lahbab red dunes, sunset photo stop, camel ride, and a BBQ dinner with live shows at our desert camp.
items.description_ar: قيادة مثيرة على الكثبان الحمراء في لهباب بسيارات الدفع الرباعي، وتوقف لالتقاط الصور عند الغروب، وركوب الجمال، وعشاء مشويات مع عروض حية في مخيمنا الصحراوي.
items.included: 4x4 dune drive, camel ride, sandboarding, BBQ dinner, soft drinks, live shows
items.included_ar: جولة الكثبان بسيارة دفع رباعي، ركوب الجمال، التزلج على الرمال، عشاء مشويات، مشروبات غازية، عروض حية

items.name: Marina Dhow Dinner Cruise
items.name_ar: رحلة عشاء على متن سفينة الداو في المارينا
items.description: Two hours on a traditional wooden dhow through Dubai Marina with an international buffet dinner and views of the skyline.
items.description_ar: ساعتان على متن سفينة داو خشبية تقليدية في مرسى دبي مع بوفيه عشاء عالمي وإطلالات على أفق المدينة.
items.included: Welcome drink, buffet dinner, soft drinks, live music
items.included_ar: مشروب ترحيبي، بوفيه عشاء، مشروبات غازية، موسيقى حية

items.name: Sunset Yacht Trip
items.description: A shared 50 ft yacht from Dubai Harbour past Ain Dubai, JBR and Atlantis, with a swim stop when the sea allows.
items.description_ar: رحلة مشتركة على يخت بطول 50 قدماً من دبي هاربر مروراً بعين دبي وجي بي آر وأتلانتس، مع توقف للسباحة عندما يسمح البحر.
items.included: Captain and crew, water and soft drinks, snacks, life jackets
items.included_ar: القبطان والطاقم، مياه ومشروبات غازية، وجبات خفيفة، سترات نجاة

items.name: Nissan Sunny
items.description: Economical automatic saloon for the city. Comprehensive insurance and 250 km a day included. Bring your driving licence and Emirates ID or passport at handover.
items.description_ar: سيارة صالون اقتصادية بناقل حركة أوتوماتيكي للمدينة. تشمل تأميناً شاملاً و250 كم يومياً. أحضر رخصة القيادة والهوية الإماراتية أو جواز السفر عند الاستلام.
items.included: Comprehensive insurance, 250 km per day, 24-hour roadside assistance
items.included_ar: تأمين شامل، 250 كم يومياً، مساعدة على الطريق على مدار الساعة

items.name: Nissan Patrol
items.description: Seven-seat 4x4 for families and road trips. Comprehensive insurance and 250 km a day included. Minimum age 25.
items.description_ar: سيارة دفع رباعي بسبعة مقاعد للعائلات والرحلات. تشمل تأميناً شاملاً و250 كم يومياً. الحد الأدنى للعمر 25 سنة.
items.included: Comprehensive insurance, 250 km per day, 24-hour roadside assistance
items.included_ar: تأمين شامل، 250 كم يومياً، مساعدة على الطريق على مدار الساعة

items.name: Gold Chiavari Chair
items.description: Gold chiavari chair with a white seat pad, for weddings and dinners. Price per chair per day.
items.description_ar: كرسي شيافاري ذهبي مع وسادة بيضاء لحفلات الزفاف والعشاء. السعر للكرسي الواحد في اليوم.

items.name: Arabic Majlis Tent 5 x 5 m
items.description: Traditional tent with carpet, floor seating for 20 guests and lighting, set up in your garden or venue.
items.description_ar: خيمة تقليدية مع سجاد وجلسة أرضية تتسع لـ 20 ضيفاً وإضاءة، نجهزها في حديقتك أو قاعتك.

items.name: Bouncy Castle 4 x 4 m
items.description: Inflatable castle for children up to 10 years, with blower and safety mats. Needs a power socket within 20 m.
items.description_ar: قلعة قابلة للنفخ للأطفال حتى عمر 10 سنوات، مع منفاخ وأرضيات أمان. تحتاج إلى مقبس كهرباء على بعد 20 متراً.

The payment could not be started. Please try again.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search this business's tours, experiences and rentals (cars, party equipment) by name, description or category. Returns prices in AED (VAT included) and the page url where the customer reserves. Call with an empty query to list everything.

params.name: query
params.description: words to look for, e.g. safari or tent; empty for all

params.name: category
params.description: only this category, e.g. Tours, Cars, Party rental

params.name: lang
params.description: en (default) or ar for Arabic names

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check one item from search_items. For a tour: the departures on a date (or the next departures when no date is given) with seats left and the price for the party. For a rental: how many units are free from start to end and the price for those days. Dates are UAE local dates, YYYY-MM-DD. Reserving and paying happen on the returned book_at page.

params.name: date
params.description: tours: the day wanted, YYYY-MM-DD; leave out for the next departures

params.name: lang
params.description: en (default) or ar for Arabic names

tools.name: business_info
tools.description: The business's name, address, licence, payment methods (share paid online by card, balance on the day), free-cancellation period, how far ahead it can be booked, and WhatsApp contact.

params.name: lang
params.description: en (default) or ar for Arabic names
